主要内容: Technavio's analysts forecast the global electric high performance vehicle market to grow at a CAGR of 72.67% during 2014-2019. The report covers the present scenario and growth prospects of the global electric high performance vehicle market for 2015-2019. It considers the unit sales of high-performance electric vehicles across all regions and presents the vendor landscape and a detailed analysis of the top six vendors operating in the market. Key regions include the Americas, APAC, and EMEA, while key vendors are BMW, Daimler, General Motors, Nissan, Renault, and Tesla. Other prominent vendors include Audi, Honda, KIA Motors, and Toyota. Market drivers include government subsidies and incentives, while challenges include high initial costs. Market trends include emission regulations encouraging OEMs to shift toward EVs. The report answers key questions about market size, growth rate, trends, challenges, key vendors, and their strengths and weaknesses.
